limitations_and_boundaries: MINO is evaluated only under the Optimal Flow Matching paradigm; applicability to other functional generative paradigms is not tested.
The benchmarks are limited to six datasets; generalization to other PDE systems or real-world applications remains to be validated.
The ablation study only examines encoder cross-attention and decoder query design; other architectural choices (e.g., number of layers, latent grid resolution) are not ablated.
Scaling experiments are limited to Navier-Stokes; data scaling behavior on irregular grids is not reported.
The paper does not provide theoretical guarantees on discretization invariance or convergence.
Computational efficiency comparisons are only made against Transolver; comparisons with other baselines on training/inference cost are not detailed.

research_questions.statement: How can functional generative models be extended to operate on arbitrary domains and irregular grids, overcoming the limitations of Fourier Neural Operator-based approaches?

experiments_or_tasks: Analyze scaling behavior and training stability across random seeds.
Compare MINO against state-of-the-art neural operators (FNO, GINO, UPT, Transolver, LNO).
Conduct ablation study on encoder cross-attention and decoder query design.
Evaluate MINO on six functional generative benchmarks covering regular and irregular grids.
Propose Mesh-Informed Neural Operator (MINO) as a domain- and discretization-agnostic backbone for generative modeling in function spaces.
Validate Sliced Wasserstein Distance (SWD) and Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) as standardized evaluation metrics for functional generative models.

methods.name: MINO-U
methods.protocol_description: MINO variant with Diffusion U-Net as latent space processor. Encoder: GNO projects input to regular grid; Decoder: cross-attention with input bypass.

methods.name: MINO-T
methods.protocol_description: MINO variant with pure Transformer-based latent processor. Encoder: GNO + cross-attention blocks; Decoder: cross-attention with input bypass.

methods.name: FNO
methods.protocol_description: Fourier Neural Operator baseline for regular grids.

methods.name: GINO
methods.protocol_description: Geometry-Informed Neural Operator: GNO encoder/decoder with FNO processor.

methods.name: UPT
methods.protocol_description: Universal Physics Transformer: GNN super-node pooling, Transformer processor.

methods.name: Transolver
methods.protocol_description: Transformer-based neural operator with slicing/de-slicing operations.
